title: Chocolate Sunflower - 2x Plug Plants - Interesting Brown/Red Sunflower
description: Sunflower ‘Chocolate’ Plug Plants – 2 Pack Add something different to your garden with these Sunflower ‘Chocolate’ plug plants. This variety produces plenty of 4–5 inch, deep chocolate-colored flowers with yellow striping on the back of each petal. Plants grow to 5–6 feet tall and spread about 18 inches, making them ideal for borders, beds, or as cut flowers. Product Details: Pack Size: 2 plug plants, ready to plant Height: 5–6 feet Spread: 18 inches Spacing: 24–36 inches apart Light: Full sun Support: May need staking in windy spots Care: Protect young plants from slugs and snails These plug plants are easy to grow and will give your garden a unique look. Just plant them out after the last frost and water regularly. Perfect for anyone wanting something a bit different from the usual sunflower.
